research.basedefense.farmer_house.desc: A house for the first settler. Place the block on flat ground and a house with a garden yard grows; a farmer moves in and puts the harvest into the house chest.
message.basedefense.research.done: %s researched "%s"! New recipe unlocked for everyone.
message.basedefense.research.locked: Research "%s" in the Base menu first
research.basedefense.rancher_house.desc: A house with an animal pen in the yard: grass, water trough and hay. A rancher moves in and puts the loot into the house chest.
message.basedefense.base.already_exists: The server already has a Base (%s, %s, %s). You can't place a second one.
screen.basedefense.needs.deposit_hint: Food goes to the food supply. Nuggets, planks, cobblestone, dense wood and constructor blocks go to storage.
message.basedefense.settlement.frozen: The settlement ran out of supplies — settlers froze! Put food and resources into the Base.
message.basedefense.settlement.unfrozen: Supplies restored — settlers are back to work!
message.basedefense.settlement.low: Settlement supplies are low: food %s, upkeep %s. At -20 settlers will freeze.
screen.basedefense.settler.status.frozen: Settlement is out of supplies — idle
screen.basedefense.settler.tip.upgrade: More loot, but more food per day
research.basedefense.cook_house.desc: A house with a brick oven and a summer kitchen in the yard. A cook moves in, turns simple food into heartier meals and puts them into the house chest.
research.basedefense.miner_house.desc: A house with a mine entrance right in the yard. A miner moves in and puts ores into the house chest.
research.basedefense.blacksmith_house.de: A blacksmith's house with a forge in the yard. A blacksmith moves in.
screen.basedefense.settler.tip.ingredien: Hold food and click — it turns into ingredient points (bread = 10)
One day of cooking uses %s points
research.basedefense.lumberjack_house.de: A house with a tree plot in the yard. A lumberjack moves in and puts logs into the house chest.
screen.basedefense.needs.rule.base: Per settler per day: 2 nuggets, 5 planks, 5 cobblestone
screen.basedefense.needs.rule.constructo: From 6 settlers: +1 constructor block per day
screen.basedefense.needs.rule.big: Over 13 settlers: 4 nuggets and 2 dense wood instead of planks
research.basedefense.farmer_house.work:
Farmer: tends the garden.
Works on his own and puts everything into the house chest. Every dawn — 3 random finds:
Lvl 1: bread ×1, beetroot ×3, potato ×2, carrot ×3, melon ×3, coins ×3
Lvl 2: bread ×1, beetroot ×5, potato ×4, carrot ×5, melon ×6, coins ×6
Lvl 3: bread ×2, beetroot ×8, potato ×6, carrot ×7, melon ×9, coins ×10
Food per day: 12 / 16 / 23
Upgrades: 20 and 60 coins
research.basedefense.rancher_house.work:
Rancher: looks after the pen.
Works on his own and puts everything into the house chest. Every dawn — 3 random finds:
Lvl 1: beef, pork, mutton or chicken ×2, eggs ×3, leather ×2, wool ×3, coins ×3
Lvl 2: meat ×3, eggs ×6, leather ×3, wool ×5, coins ×6
Lvl 3: meat ×5, eggs ×10, leather ×5, wool ×8, coins ×10
Food per day: 13 / 18 / 25
Upgrades: 20 and 60 coins
research.basedefense.cook_house.work:
Cook: give him food from your hand — it becomes ingredient points (bread = 10). With 30 points he cooks one dish per day into the house chest:
Lvl 1: pumpkin pie 2–3, cake 1–2, beetroot soup 2–3 or bread 3–4
Lvl 2: pie 3–4, cake 2–3, soup 3–5, bread 4–6 or coins ×10
Lvl 3: same, but coins ×15
Food per day: 12 / 16 / 23
Upgrades: 20 and 60 coins
research.basedefense.miner_house.work:
Miner: works at the bottom of the mine.
Works on his own and puts everything into the house chest. Every dawn — 2 random finds:
Lvl 1: iron ore 4–5, gold ore 2–3, copper ore 8–10, coal 9–12
Lvl 2: iron ore 6–7, gold ore 4–5, coal 15–18, diamond ×1, coins ×10
Lvl 3: iron ore 10–14, gold ore 6–8, coal 20–22, diamonds ×2, coins ×13
Food per day: 13 / 18 / 25
Upgrades: 20 and 60 coins
research.basedefense.blacksmith_house.wo:
The blacksmith's work comes later. For now he just lives in the settlement.
Food per day: 6
research.basedefense.lumberjack_house.wo:
Lumberjack: chops trees on the plot.
Works on his own and puts everything into the house chest. Every dawn — logs of one random kind:
Lvl 1: 16 logs
Lvl 2: 25 logs
Lvl 3: 35 logs and 6 coins
Food per day: 12 / 16 / 23
Upgrades: 20 and 60 coins
